propositions: _paged_search loops unbounded when a server ignores startAt offsets and repeats the same page, advancing the local offset but never receiving new data; exit condition (batch empty) becomes unreachable

Fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites swallow any abort the pager raises, converting it to a silent degraded snapshot rather than propagating the error

A startAt-ignoring server was measured requesting offsets [0,3,6,9,12,15,...] repeatedly and receiving the same 3-issue page 26 times until harness cap; expected behaviour is termination within 2 calls

The fix requires tracking the previous page's first issue key and raising BackendPaginationStallError on ANY repeated page (short or full), then re-raising the error ahead of all four broad exception handlers to prevent absorption
